Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: unimplemented.

SourceIdentity is intentionally exhaustive for FixationCsv and TrialInventoryCsv; its parser/schema matching has no ASC case. That confirms Phase 1’s completion boundary and the Phase 2 gap, rather than suggesting an accidental omission in callers. Add a typed ASC source format, definition identity, options schema, codec/laws, and replay path, then exercise a real ASC admission/replay fixture. Do not relabel CSV identity as ASC merely to close the ticket.

Evidence:
- plan/src/main/scala/eyes4s/plan/SourceIdentity.scala:22
- plan/src/main/scala/eyes4s/plan/SourceIdentity.scala:58
- codec/src/main/scala/eyes4s/codec/SourceIdentityCodec.scala:91

Remaining / next action: Implement ASC semantic identity, codec/laws, and replay/admission coverage.

Disposition: Keep open.
